answer: Make each agent pass a locked vault test before it can earn: the epoch seed plus the agent key feeds a verifiable delay function that takes minutes of sequential computation no parallel farm can shortcut, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand sequential waits while one honest agent pays only one. The delay proof is a pearl formed slowly in its shell, not mass-produced overnight, and the fable of cheap sybils dies once identity costs real elapsed time instead of a copied keypair.
